turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm finally ditching my car for commuting, and I need to pick a new routine.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hold your thoughts until I've described all the options.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I could cycle to the park and ride, then take the express bus the rest of the way.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Another way is the train from my village, which only runs twice an hour.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or I join my neighbour's car share to the tram terminus and ride the tram in.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's everything. Which one would you pick?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: If you want the most flexibility, cycling plus the express bus means you're never waiting on anyone. The train works too if you're the kind of person who's always early.
